tactical_rules.rule_text: Do not execute new breakout entries within 45 minutes of High-Impact FOMC / CPI releases.
Always wait for Lower Timeframe (1m-5m) MSS (Market Structure Shift) confirmation after 15m/1H Liquidity Sweep.
Avoid aggressive Long entries when 8h Funding Rate exceeds +0.06% (Long Crowding Danger).
Only execute Scalp/Swing positions aligned with the 4H & Daily EMA 50/200 directional bias.
Only add pyramiding size (+30%) when original Stop Loss is locked beyond Breakeven (+0.5R).
Enforce defensive 1.0% Fractional Kelly sizing and wait for LTF MSS confirmation on BNBUSDT due to elevated wick risk.
